confirmed.finding: Uint256RadixKey has implicit size_t conversion and no equality operators; radix leaf comparisons can use only low64. Isolate correctness repair first, with same-low64/high-bit-different miss/insert/remove tests.

ImmutableSnapshotTag constructor explicitly requires immutable source or exclusive writer held across root sharing. No-argument pinSnapshot on arbitrary live tree would violate this contract. Atomic shared_ptr publication is not a portable lock-free guarantee.

Entry refcount protects lifetime, not mutable modified fee/parents/children. get/exists may use safe membership index; info requires synchronized/immutable metadata. Tree/map/count clear and re-admission publication must be coherent.

Flag/count/log and membership transitions need one linearization/lifecycle protocol. Removing live-tree member before clearing flag loses count decrement. Setting true before counter/log while removal races can underflow counters or strand log entries. No-snapshot-publication must preserve RPC field freshness and pinned-view semantics.
Dirty log needs deletion tombstones, remove/readd within publication epoch, clear/reset, epoch rollover, and notification dedup; live-entry stamp alone not a complete deletion log.

Retained wire trades CPU for additional bytes/caches/allocator classes; all ownership constructors/default/arena and full serialization contexts must retain canonical bytes. Shared plaintext payload requires all Copy/transport/checksum/compression/send-completion users, not just PushMessage; encrypted/per-peer outputs cannot generally be shared.

Individual staged admission differs from atomic package API. Preserve package fee/conflict/dependency/error behavior, per-request atomicity, and notification/promise completion ordering. Bound coordinator by tx count+bytes+holdtime/fairness, not4096request objects; direct fallback must not silently violate existing order.
